第45章 没劲儿了吧？来一瓶？-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

下一章

许默受伤，对二人来说简直是心腹大患。

他们都有点不敢让老枪回来住了。

方芸一边扛着许默往营地走，一边吐槽，说许默伤的简直不是时候。

许默拧着脖子：“这事儿还能分时候？”

两人丝毫没有注意到。

许默的肩伤，一溜血印儿滑落下来，滴在树叶和碎石上。

等回到营地，方芸早就气喘吁吁。

体力值已经降到了70以下。

她虽然自诩为女战士，但体力力量并非长项。

更何况又是生理期，盗汗乏力多喘，没痛经宫寒就算万幸了。

许默从背包里掏出酒曲，调出酿造界面。

有幸存值就是有底气。

人参，鹿茸，水，糖，蜂蜜，柠檬汁，维生素C，酒曲，全部加入。

再加点氨基酸！

【获得西鹏特饮（酒精版）X1】

后面介绍都不用看，许默就知道它是干嘛用的。

“没劲儿了吧？来一瓶？”

方芸早就知道了许默的能力。

他时不时就能拿出这种有特殊功能的饮料来。

许默酿的酒，都是有大大好处的。

当下接过西鹏特饮酒，直接一饮而尽！

两人抬头，天色见黄昏，老枪还没回来，心中担心同时，也不由得加快脚步进营地。

一个伤员，一个病号，哪还有功夫瞎担心别人？

下一刻。

“嗷呜——”

凄厉的狼嚎声从石林外围撕裂风声，此起彼伏，如同一张无形的大网向营地收拢。

壁炉的火苗如同风中残烛，疯狂摇曳。

许默耳畔传来一阵细微的振翅嗡鸣。蜂后的精神波动直接在脑海中炸开。

“主人！大狗狗，一群！”

十二只啸月狼。

领头的是银鬃狼王，绿色品质。

综合实力评估：六十五。

许默眼角狠狠一抽，瞳孔中倒映着摇晃的火光。

六十五的战力已经不容小觑，更别提这是一支配合默契的狼群。

不过......

瓦力最近是不是闲着来着？

他抬脚踢了踢正趴在地上吸能量的瓦力，用下巴点了点远处的狼群。

Xu Mo's injury was a serious concern for the two of them.

They were all a little afraid to let Lao Qiang come back to live.

As Fang Yun carried Xu Mo towards the camp, she complained that Xu Mo was injured at the wrong time.

Xu Mo twisted his neck: "Can we wait for this matter?"

Neither of them noticed at all.

A trail of blood slid down from Xu Mo's shoulder injury, dripping on the leaves and gravel.

By the time she returned to the camp, Fang Yun was already out of breath.

The physical strength value has dropped below 70.

Although she calls herself a female warrior, physical strength is not her strong point.

What's more, it's my menstrual period again. I have night sweats, fatigue, and panting. I'm lucky if I don't have dysmenorrhea or uterine cold.

Xu Mo took out the koji from his backpack and brought up the brewing interface.

Having survival value means having confidence.

Add ginseng, deer antler, water, sugar, honey, lemon juice, vitamin C, and distiller's yeast.

Add some more amino acids!

[Get Xipeng Special Drink (Alcoholic Version) X1]

Xu Mo knew what it was used for without even reading the introduction.

"Are you feeling bored? Want a bottle?"

Fang Yun has long known Xu Mo's ability.

From time to time, he can come up with this kind of drink with special functions.

The wine made by Xu Mo is of great benefit.

He immediately took the drink from Xipengte and drank it all in one gulp!

The two of them looked up, seeing that it was already dusk and Lao Qiang hadn't come back yet. They were worried and couldn't help but speed up and enter the camp.

A wounded person, a sick person, how can he have time to worry about others?

The next moment.

"Ouch——"

The shrill howls of wolves ripped through the wind from the periphery of the stone forest, one after another, like a large invisible net closing in on the camp.

The fire in the fireplace swayed wildly like a candle in the wind.

A subtle buzzing sound came from Xu Mo's ears.The Queen Bee's mental fluctuations exploded directly in her mind.

"Master! Big dogs, a bunch of them!"

Twelve howling moon wolves.

The leader is the silver-maned wolf king, green quality.

Comprehensive strength assessment: sixty-five.

The corners of Xu Mo's eyes twitched fiercely, and the swaying firelight reflected in his pupils.

The combat power of Sixty Five cannot be underestimated, not to mention that this is a wolf pack that works well together.

But...

Has Wall-E been idle lately?

He raised his foot and kicked Wali, who was lying on the ground absorbing energy, and tapped the wolves in the distance with his chin.
